signature: FVector FindGroundLocationAt(UWorld* World, AActor* IgnoreActor, FVector InLocation, float TraceStartZ, float TraceEndZ, FName TraceName)

callees.0x141eede00: helper: default result is InLocation; on Athena-style game states with a MapInfo runs one line trace in the column at InLocation between TraceStartZ and TraceEndZ
callees.0x1440b5c60: UWorld line trace single by profile (engine); profile name passed through the TraceName argument (proposed UWorld::LineTraceSingleByProfile)

notes: The trace tag FName 'FindGroundLocationAt' is a static name in the native code. The TraceName argument reaches the trace call as the profile; the native 4-argument call in the capture hides the rest of the argument list, so the profile mapping is MEDIUM. Ignore-actor insertion is inferred from the stored IgnoreActor value.
